Lower part: Syriac lines, then Latin italic translation, then Arabic-script lines at the foot. Signature "B 2" at the bottom centre. No margin notes.

main_text.p: telligi; Vocatio enim in tempore sive ad vitam æternam, sive ad Apostolatum fit propter electionem æternam, illa est testis & signum hujus; sicut hæc est causa, & fundamentum illius. Nam Deo ab æterno cognita sunt omnia opera ejus, ita ut electio h. e. vocatio, quæ fit in tempore, certissimum sit argumentum electionis ante fundationem mundi. Sed & de Sp. Sancto, idem ex divinis ejus circa electos operibus colligitur. Eph. 1. 13. ἐν ᾧ καὶ πιστεύ-σαντες ἐσφραγίσθητε τῷ πνεύματι τῆς ἐπαγγελίας τῷ ἁγίῳ, 1. Cor. 6:11, ἀλλὰ ἡγιάσθητε, ἀλλὰ ἐδικαιώθητε, ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ, καὶ ἐν τῷ πνεύματι τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν. Actor. 13. 2. εἶπε τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον· ἀφορίσατέ δή μοι τὸν τε Βαρνάβαν καὶ τὸν Σαῦλον εἰς τὸ ἔργον, ὃ προσκέκλημαι αὐτούς.

X. Unde patet Deum causam esse, ut electionis, ita etiam reproba-tionis, qui enim ex omnibus aliquos tantum eligit, is alios non eligit, & proinde præterit in eligendo; adeoque reprobat. Hoc vult Scriptura, cum dicit אהבתי את יעקב ואת עשו שנאתי Mal. 1, 2. 3. ubi amor, significat gratiam & misericordiam erga Jacobum. Odium, judicium antece-dens mala opera ætatis & temporis consequentis Esavi, & in comparatione gratiæ, sive electionis Jacobi, ejus reprobationem. Unde ut Jacobus electorum: ita Esavus reproborum certum est exemplum. Chaldæus utitur voce רחיקית re-probavi, repuli, elongavi à me. Deinde Jer. 6: 30. כסף נמאס קראו להם כי מאס יהוה בהם argentum improbum vocati sunt, quia reprobavit Dominus ipsos. Syrus vertit [illegible, ~4 letters] argentum contemtum, despectum, re-probum, rejiciendum, abominandum.

XI. Quod ad secundum, seu fundamentum electionis attinet; illud est merum Dei beneplacitum, quo in certis quibusdam hominibus gratio-sam suam gratiam manifestare voluit. 2. Timoth. 1:9. 10. Τῷ σώσαντι ἡμᾶς, καὶ καλέσαντι κλήσει ἁγίᾳ, οὐ κατὰ τὰ ἔργα ἡμῶν, ἀλλὰ κατ' ἰδίαν πρόθεσιν, καὶ χάριν τὴν δοθεῖσαν ἡμῖν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ πρὸ χρόνων αἰωνίων, φανερωθεῖσαν δὲ νῦν διὰ τῆς ἐπιφανείας τοῦ σωτῆρος ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ [?]. [illegible, ~30 letters] [illegible, ~30 letters] [illegible, ~30 letters] * [illegible, ~30 letters] Ille qui servavit nos & vocavit nos vocatione sanctâ;non secundum (sicut) opera nostra. sed secundum voluntatem suam,& bonitatem suam:illam (scil.) quæ data est nobis in Jesu Christo ante tempus æternitatum. Et revelata est jam in revelatione servato-ris nostri Jesu Christi. [illegible, ~30 letters] [illegible, ~10 letters]

page.notes: The Syriac and Arabic-script lines at the foot (after the Greek of 2 Tim. 1:9-10) could not be read letter by letter, so they are marked illegible. The line-initial Syriac word in the Jeremiah gloss is also illegible. The Greek of 2 Tim. 1:9 and Acts 13:2 is transcribed from a low-resolution scan and may contain small errors. The italic/roman split in the Latin translation of 2 Tim. 1:9-10 is uncertain. The Hebrew of Mal. 1:2-3 and Jer. 6:30 is copied without vowel points, as printed. The "B 2" signature is at the bottom centre. Faint show-through text at the lower left and right is ignored.
